en: Wh-what do we do now?
Without the Xuanwu Sword, the Array's seal can't be broken?
This...
Is there really nothing we can do? What now?
Actually, there is a way...
Really? What is it?
It's...
Say no more, Chijingzi!
Please, let me finish, Master Yuanshi!
But...
Gather six people as strong as me, and unleash all our power at once. Slam that into the Array's seal, and we may buy half an incense stick of safe time!
But if you do that...
It's a road of no return. But there's truly no other way. Isn't that so, Master Yuanshi?
Th-this...
I'll go!
Count me in!
Good! With me, we need three more!
Add us three and that makes six!
Huanglong, Puxian, Guangchengzi... you all came!
How could you leave us out of this?
So unfriendly of you, Chijingzi~
Ho ho ho~ Let me be clear: this is no pleasure trip!
We know! If it helps Pingyan finish the Investiture, our lives won't be wasted!
Y-you all...
Master Yuanshi... thank you for all your care. Forgive me for leaving your side...
Young man!
What is it, sage?
May our six lives buy peace for the world. The world and the Investiture are in your hands, General Star Pingyan~
Rest easy! I swear on the name Pingyan, I won't let you down!
Hurry to the Array! The safe time lasts only half an incense stick. Don't let their sacrifice be in vain!
Got it! I'm heading to the Array now!
Only half an incense stick left. I've got to hurry to the Array!
I'd better go back to Yuanshi.
Chijingzi and five other sages gave their lives to buy this time. Do not betray their sacrifice!
I won't let it be for nothing. Oh, how's that idiot Weirdbeak doing?
My disciple is training hard on Mount Zhongnan. Don't worry.
Ha ha, that weird bird studying? That's a first!
Hurry into the Array! I'll follow right behind!
Master! You came?
This Array is no ordinary formation. Be doubly careful, disciple.
I'll heed your words, Master! I won't be careless!
This is the final showdown between Jie and Chan. Time is short, enter the Array! I'll be right behind you!
Chijingzi... I won't let your sacrifice be in vain! Rest in peace!
Say, disciple, why'd you marry a pretty bride without telling me?
You've got it wrong, Master! You were off wandering, and I had no idea where you were. So... so... please forgive me!
Ha ha ha ha... Silly boy, I was just testing you. Of course I know your heart. I don't blame you!
Chanyu greets you, Master!
Ha ha ha... rise, rise! My disciple's a simple soul, but kind and caring. Marrying you is fate earned over three lifetimes.
You're too kind, Master.
The seal's closing! Hurry in! I'll guard you from nearby!
Time's running out! The Array's seal is about to close!
Got it! We're off!
Go in first! I'll follow right after!
Heh... who knew the Chan Sect had such fearless fools~ Throwing away lives to break our seal! But now that you're inside my Array, you won't leave alive!
Now that we're in, I, Pingyan, won't fail Chijingzi and the sages who died for this!
Die!
Hmph! Not tough at all!
Heh heh... It seems I underestimated you. For that, I, Lingya Sage, humbly apologize...
Got any more tricks? Bring 'em on!
Then open your eyes wide, and feel it with your bodies!
Turned into a big dumb elephant and talking big?!
No! That form is nothing like the Lingya Sage of a moment ago!
Right! The hag's got no eye for it!
Hmph! Hey, Monkey-face! Instead of standing there admiring it, why not spend that time beating this big dumb elephant?
Good point! Let's go!
That's more like it!
Cu... curse you brats...
Huff... told ya... it's just... a big dumb elephant! Huff...
W-well said! Huff... huff...
Let's hurry to the next floor!
You beat Lingya Sage?! Then I must fight at full strength from the start!
Not another transformation?
First a big dumb elephant, now a big dumb turtle!
Die!
Cursed brats... To think I, Wuyun Sage, would lose to you... Don't get cocky. There are many far stronger than me... I go first... Your Majesty...
After the big elephant came a big turtle. Next floor better not be a golden monkey!
Hag, you think this Array is a monster encyclopedia?
Hmph! If it were, you'd be in it too!
Why you!
Okay, you two, quit bickering. Let's keep going!
For my brother's sake, generous me won't bother with a petty hag!
Who're you calling petty? Spell it out!
Whoever answers, that's who! Ha ha ha ha...
Hmph!
Transform!
Gold...en...
M-monkey?!
Ha ha ha ha... Terrified by my true form? For centuries, no one who's seen it has survived. And you're no exception!
Look, look... I called it! It really is a golden monkey!
Sis, you're a prophet!
Heh heh... Monkey-face~ Still gonna look down on me?
Hmph! Lucky guess! Big deal!
What'd you say, Monkey-face?!
Excuse me...
It wasn't luck!
It was if I say so!
Was not!
What is it? Spit it out! Can't you see I'm busy?
I'm saying this isn't the time to argue...
Hag~ let's call a truce!
Agreed! Let's team up and take out this golden monkey first!
Careful, Monkey-face!
You too, hag~ I can't split myself to save you!
The farce is over! Die~
Let's go! On to the next floor!
Hope it's not another shape-shifter...
Brats who dare kill my Jie Sect kin, prepare to die!
Lingya... Wuyun... Jinguang... I'm coming, sisters...
Bring out the Investiture List, Monkey-face...
Mm...
Why must the Jie and Chan Sects fight each other like this? I don't get it!
If you got it, you'd be an immortal, not standing here!
Don't overthink it, brother.
Right now, let's focus on how to break through the Array!
Tu Xingsun agrees with Chanyu!
If you had to find a reason behind every word and deed of everyone you meet, wouldn't that be exhausting?
Princess Long Ji is right! Fine, I'll stop overthinking. On to the next floor!
That's the spirit, Monkey-face~
Huh? Why is no one guarding this floor?
Who cares! No guard means we just head straight down!
Good point! Let's go!
Yin Wen~ please, can we stop? I don't want revenge anymore!
Do you know what you're saying, Ao Zhu?! Why did you leave your post?
You've become so frightening. Is all this necessary? You're already ruler of Shang. Who stands higher than you? Why sacrifice so many lives for the Array?
I may rule Shang, but the Xiqi rebels still plot to topple my throne. Only when I've wiped them all out will my heart know peace!
Yin Wen...
Yin Wen... no! Perhaps I should call you Wen Zhong, ruler of Shang.
Ha ha ha ha ha... It's you, Pingyan~
Give up your ambitions! I won't let you plunge the world into darkness!
Heh heh heh... You think you can stop me?
Wanna find out?
Die! You killed my father!
Miss Ao Zhu...
Ping...yan... run... run away... You can't... beat... Yin Wen!
M-Miss Ao Zhu...
Miss Ao Zhu! Why would you... could it be...
Yin Wen has... changed. He's not... the Yin Wen... I knew... Now he... only obeys... Lady Daji... I hate you all... but only you... can save... Yin Wen...
Die!
Look out~ Pingyan...
Ha ha ha ha ha ha...
Brother! Monkey-face...
Brother... are... you okay?
Heh... I'm hanging in... Are you okay, Miss Ao Zhu?
Why did you save me...
B-because... I wanted to... make it up to you...
R-right...
Ha ha ha ha ha... I knew it. Someone like you was bound to jump in!
Heh heh... You really... are my... childhood friend...
Die~ Pingyan!
I... I won't... die here!
Ugh...
Ha ha ha ha ha ha... You're no match for me after all!
Damn it...
Any last words?
Wake... up... Yin Wen... Kill me... if you must... but let... my friends go...
What... are you saying... brother...
R-right... If we die... we die... Don't beg... him...
W-well said... you... nag...
Y-you too... she-devil...
R-right! Kill us if you will...
It's fate...
Those are your last words? Die!
M-Miss... Ao Zhu...
Wh...why...?
Only... you can... stop Yin Wen now... Please... take care of... Yin Wen... Pingyan...
Miss Ao Zhu...
Heh... so in the end, she betrayed me too! No matter. Nobody's left to get in my way. Die!
St...op~
Wh-what are you doing, Yin Wen?! You regained consciousness?!
I... I... won't let you... hurt my friends...
Get back down there, brat!
I won't...
Huff... Cu... cursed brat~
Yin... Wen...
Relax! I won't kill you now! But only for now!
What... are you... after?
You'll find out soon enough! Hu Ximei!
Hu Ximei?
Your shape-shifting gets ever better! Now, take the brat's three divine swords!
Do you defy me, Hu Ximei?
N-no, sir...
Ha ha ha ha ha... Now all four divine swords are mine! Ha ha ha ha ha...
Hu... Xi... mei... You're the one... who made... Su... Daji...
Let's go. It's time!
Yes...
Ah... Hu... Xi... mei...
Can I help you?
20 silver a night.
Daji... don't leave me! Huff... huff...
It's all right now, child~
M-Master... I... I...
Say no more! I understand. I understand everything...
Master~
The battle of the Array cost far more lives than I foresaw. Rest well tonight. We'll plan once you wake!
Mm...
Brother... you okay...?
Mm...
Rest easy, you two! I'll keep watch!
Thanks... sis...
Leaving it... to you... h-hag...
Hmph! You could've skipped that last part!
Master~ Will Monkey-face and the others be okay?
Hard to say. Their wounds are too deep, their spirits nearly shattered... If they last three days, I'd be surprised... Alas, what to do...
What do we do? Is there really no way?
Perhaps we can only trust in Heaven! I am powerless...
You two fools...
H-Hu Ximei!
Wretched witch! Barging in here alone? You must have a death wish!
Tu Xingsun won't let you touch a hair on Pingyan's head!
No! You've misunderstood!
Save it! Explain it in hell! Prepare to die, witch!
Wait~ Sister Yang Jian!
You're protecting this witch, Sister Long Ji? If not for her... Monkey-face and... and... *sob*...
I understand... I don't know why Hu Ximei is here, but I sense no killing intent in her eyes. I don't think she came to kill Pingyan.
You must be Princess Long Ji, daughter of the Jade Emperor. Wise indeed.
You flatter me! I merely trust my instincts! So the reason you came...
I came to repay Pingyan for saving my children at the Xuanyuan Tomb!
You're the mother of those little foxes?!
I am!
If Monkey-face saved your kids, why help Yin Wen steal our three divine swords?
I hated doing it. But as a Jie Sect disciple, I can never betray my sect. So even though he saved my life...
Then what good is coming here now?! Can you wake them up?
I can't promise, but I'll try. The Jie Sect's forbidden art~ Soul-Return Spell!
Sister Long Ji, do you know this Soul-Return Spell?
Yes, I've heard of it... You truly mean to use it?
Yes! My mind is made up!
Do you understand how grave this technique is?
I do!
So you're already resolved... Alas~ how cruel Heaven is~ Why must we be enemies?
I suppose it's fate! I'm beginning!
Mm!
Soul-Return Spell!!!!
Why did that witch turn back into a fox?
Don't tell me she's running back to Yin Wen!
She won't!
How do you know, Sister Long Ji?
She's lost a thousand years of power. She can never be Hu Ximei again...
Could it be... because of that Soul-Return Spell?
Yes! To cast it, one must push one's power to the absolute limit. But once it's done, the body can't withstand the backlash, and the caster loses all the power they've cultivated over the years...
So Hu Ximei will forever~
Yes! She must live forever as an ordinary fox...
So then...
We misjudged Hu Ximei...
Tu Xingsun misjudged Hu Ximei too...
Alas~ fate is cruel~
Huh? What's this? A Townsman's Token?
Ugh...
Mm... it's morning already...
Monkey-face~ you're awake?
Sis... did you stay up all night?
Mm... I'm so glad you woke up...
Ugh, the first thing I see when I wake up is you~ hag~
You can't say one nice thing, can you!
Why thank you!
Sis, what happened last night?
Well... here's the thing...
So Hu Ximei...
Yes! To repay you, she spent a thousand years of power on the Soul-Return Spell to save you. Now she's lost all her magic. Hu Ximei is just an ordinary little fox now...
I see... So my brother's and my old hides were saved by my enemy... How ironic~ How can I hate Hu Ximei now? Right, brother~
... For now, the only thing we can do for Hu Ximei is beat Yin Wen, stop his ambitions, and bring peace back to this suffering world. That's the best gift for everyone who died for this!
Well said, Monkey-face!
Zhaoge is just ahead! Let's get moving!
This trip to Zhaoge may be a one-way road. I don't want you dying for me. I won't force you to come along...
What are you saying, Monkey-face? Don't you trust us?
Sis is right! Wherever you go, brother, I'm with you all the way, no questions asked!
Right! Tu Xingsun's going too!
A wife follows her husband. I'm going too!
I shall go as well!
Y-you guys...
That's what comrades in life and death are for~
Mm...
Were you just crying, Monkey-face~?
Wh-who's crying?
Then why are your eyes red?
I... I... Oh! Some sand got in them!
Really?
You're so annoying!
Tee hee hee...
It's getting late! Let's go!
Ho ho ho...
Laugh again and I'm leaving you here!
Heh heh... Okay! Okay! Let's go!
Ho ho ho ho ho... We meet again!
Too bad! You still lack the Townsman's Token...
Ho ho ho... A General Star indeed! Impressive, truly impressive!
Dare to take our trial? It's full of danger, but clear it and your power will soar!
Are you ready?
I see. Come back when you're ready!
Come find us brothers when you're ready!
You truly have a general's mettle! Be careful!
Take care!
The battle of the Array cost so many lives...
Since leaving the mountain, Yang Jian, you've grown a lot!
Master... it's all thanks to you!
Damn the Jie Sect!
Tu Xingsun did well too!
Thank you, Master! Tu Xingsun will try even harder!
Let's see if Master Yuanshi has a plan!
Mm!

Shen Gongbao and Yin Wen used dark magic to fuse the four swords into the God-Slaying Sword. To fulfill the Investiture, we must get Pangu's Divine Blade from Kaitian Cave on Mount Kunlun. Only it can match that sword...
Kaitian Cave? Pangu's Divine Blade?
Without Pangu's Blade, no one can face Yin Wen's God-Slaying Sword. The Investiture would be a pipe dream.
Right! I'll seal Shen Gongbao back into the List!
Did I say something wrong?
Now that it's come to this, there's no point hiding it any longer!
Hiding what?
Have you seen the names on the Investiture List?
Of course! Why?
Then you know who the last two names are?
Wen Zhong and Daji, right?
Yes! Do you know who they really are?
D-don't tell me...
Yes! Wen Zhong has possessed Yin Wen, and Daji is...
Xiaojun?!
Exactly!
I knew it...
Pingyan...
Don't worry, Master Yuanshi! When the time comes, I know what I must do... After all, the Three Realms are at stake...
I understand! Let me send you to the sacred Kaitian Cave on Mount Kunlun!
Thank you!
Are you ready?
I see. Come find me when you're ready.
Good! Then let us be off!
Mm!
Zhaoge is just ahead! Fight carefully!
Got it!
At last, the final battle! Take care!
Be careful!
Master... I won't let you down!
Damn the Jie Sect! We can never coexist!
Tu Xingsun, you must keep Chanyu safe!
Thank you, Master! Tu Xingsun will!
This is Zhaoge!
Sigh~ I thought life would get better after King Zhou died, but the new emperor is even crueler!
Zhaoge has a tower called Zhaixing Tower. They say Yin Wen killed King Zhou there. Princes Yin Hong and Yin Jiao were framed!
With all the fighting lately, lots of folks have moved out of Zhaoge!
They say all of Heishan Town died to power the forbidden Array!
How long will these chaotic times last?
I hear Lord Ji Chang of Xiqi has finally answered the people's hopes and raised an army against Zhaoge. I hope they march in soon!
So Dad's already marched! Shang's luck has run out. It's Heaven's will!
I've got relatives in Heishan Town. I wonder how they're doing...
I'm joining the army when I grow up!
Will a savior ever come to rescue this country?
Heard about Mrs. Fang? Her husband died fighting the Xiqi army. And get this: as soon as she heard, she remarried! Isn't that outrageous?
He's not my own son, but I'll love him like my own!
I'm so glad I met you, dear...
Mom wove this handkerchief for Dad!
That's right! I made it for my good-for-nothing late husband! But why do you have it?
Uh...
Oh well! That's all in the past! Our family's doing fine now! Thanks for bringing the handkerchief back, though!
N-no problem...
It's a small token, but please take it!
Okay! Thanks!
Got 5000 silver!
That's all in the past! We're doing fine now!
I wonder how Dad's doing?
Don't you worry! I'll take good care of you!
*sob sob*... My child... Rushuang...
Ha ha ha ha ha ha... Told ya~ your wife was bound to remarry! And don't worry about the kid! He's got a new dad! Ha ha ha...
A-are you done laughing? I'll teach you a lesson!
Okay! Okay! Just kidding! Let's go back!
Mm... farewell~ my child~ Rushuang~
Why'd it suddenly get so cold?
Yeah, I just had the strangest familiar feeling!
I feel like somebody just kicked me in the butt!
I think I heard Dad tell me to be good and listen to Mom...
Could it be...
All my years roaming the love scene, and I'm still a bachelor! Back then the ladies called me a great Casanova! Sigh~
I really want to enlist! I want to do something for my country! But my wife won't let me!
Hmph! Always on about serving the country! In times like these, if he dies, what about me and our unborn baby?
So boring~ All my friends moved away!
Ha ha ha ha ha... ha! Die, Pingyan~
Take this, Yin Wen!
Pangu's Divine Blade broke?!
Heh heh... Not bad! You actually got Pangu's Divine Blade?
Heh heh heh... You flatter me!
Xi... Xiaojun?
So you're the famed General Star, Pingyan? You look like the most ordinary brat ever~ Yet you broke the Array my lord and I made!
Xiaojun! It's me~ Ayan! Don't you recognize me?
Ayan? Ho ho ho... I have heard that name in this girl's mind! But sadly~ you two will never meet again!
Wh-who are you?! What have you done to Xiaojun?!
Me? I am Daji, empress of the Shang dynasty. Ho ho ho! So hot-headed? Don't say I didn't warn you: if I die, this girl dies too!
I-is that true?
Ho ho ho ho ho... So what will you do, General Star Pingyan~?
You...!
Monkey-face...

Ha ha ha ha ha! Well, Pingyan? Kill me, and Yin Wen dies too! Long ago, when I, Wen Zhong, marched on the barbarians, their dark magic destroyed my body. By luck, this boy Yin Wen fell from the sky, and I moved my spirit into him. Heh! He resisted at first, but once he tasted the power that came with joining me, he couldn't let go!
Shut up! If you think that'll make me back down, you're dead wrong! I'm ready for the worst! I've known Yin Wen and Xiaojun for over ten years. If they were here, they'd back me up!
Well said, Monkey-face~
Ho ho ho... What a touching friendship~ As a show of sincerity, I'll fight you in my true form!
W-we won?
Huff... huff... Ayan...
Xi... Xiaojun?
Huff... huff... Ayan... help... me up...
Don't trust her! She's not Xiaojun!
Xiaojun...
You're... still... too green...
Monkey-face~
Brother~
Ugh...
Brother! Are you okay?! Hang in there!
You idiot! I told you it was a trick! Why did you... idiot idiot idiot...
Hey nag, is this really the time? Instead of yelling at him, think of a way to save Pingyan!
The hag's... right... I really... am an... idiot...
What's going on?
What is it? What's this strange demonic aura?
Sh... Shen Gongbao!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha... I've waited so long for this! The moment of my master Tongtian's full revival has finally come! The world is ours at last!
Tongtian? Who's that? Spit it out!
You'll find out soon enough! Ha ha ha ha ha...
What's going on? I've got a bad feeling about this! And brother's badly hurt. What do we do?
Fear not!
It's Pangu and Nuwa!
Leave these little wounds to us!
Hah!
I-I'm healed? Awesome!
Don't celebrate too soon! The real show's just starting!
Do you want to save your two childhood friends?
Yes! Of course I do!

Good! Then listen closely! The Nine-Tail Fox and Wen Zhong possessing your friends are badly weakened. Nuwa and I will hold down Yin Wen's and Xiaojun's spirits, and you'll seal the Fox and Wen Zhong into the Investiture List!
Got it! Then they'll have a chance to go back to normal!
But I can't promise it'll work! Still, it's the only chance! Will you try?
Of course!
Good! Let's begin!
Not yet! Hold on!
Focus your spirit, Pingyan!
Aaah~~~~ Yin Wen~ Xiaojun~
Huff... huff...
Nice... work... huff... huff...
Th-thanks... to you...
Next, we restore their strength!
Mm!
Ugh...
Ayan~ you finally came!
You okay, Yin Wen?!
...I'm sorry, Pingyan.
Don't be silly! No matter what, we're friends forever!
Thank you.
Ayan~ *sob sob*...
